newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar plans offshore oilfield maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Qatar plans offshore oilfield maintenance.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) is planning fourth quarter maintenance work at two of its main offshore oilfields, a QGPC official said on Wednesday.
Oil traders based in Qatar estimated that the work would trim between 15 and 20 percent from the Qatar Marine export programme at the height of the work.
Qatar Marine exports typically run at 190,000 barrels per day (bpd).

The 55,000 bpd Maydan Mahzam offshore field (Production Station-2) is scheduled to be shut down from October 15 to November 4 to allow topside improvements and maintenance inspection, the official said.
Similar work is planned for the 85,000 bpd Bul Hanine field (PS-3) which will be shut between November 12 and December 2.
Oil from the two fields is piped to Halul Island for stoarge and export.
Qatari production is running at 480,000 bpd, industry sources in the Gulf estimate.
The 35,000 bpd Al-Rayyan, operated by Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO), is due on stream in October and will be marketed as a separate grade for offshore tanker.
The first export of condensate from the Qatargas project is expected late this week.
